管理任务执行、运行环境和记录保留。: Manage task execution, environments, and record retention.
暂时无法读取运行设置。: Runtime settings could not be loaded.
每个后端实例同时执行的任务数量。: Number of tasks each backend instance can run at once.
超过时间仍未开始的任务将停止等待。: Queued tasks fail if they have not started within this time.
包括排队、执行、等待确认或回答及取消中的任务。: Includes queued, running, awaiting confirmation or input, and cancelling tasks.
按用户在同一企业中的任务数量计算。: Counted separately for each user within an organization.
当前任务执行期间，可追加的消息数量。: Messages that can be queued while the current task runs.
在原回复中重试，可展开查看中断前的内容。设为 0 可关闭。: Retries appear in the same reply. Expand previous attempts to see their content. Set to 0 to turn off.
模型请求未单独设置等待时间时使用。: Used when a model request does not specify its own timeout.
填 0 按后端可用内存自动确定。: Use 0 to determine the limit from backend memory.
适用于上下文长度不少于一百万的模型。: For models with a context length of at least one million.
模型上下文中较早工具结果保留的摘要大小。: Summary size retained for older tool results in model context.
每次读取文件内容的大小上限。: Maximum content size for each file read.
与读取内容大小共同限制单次读取。: Both the size and line limit apply to each read.
批量返回内容上限相对于单次返回上限的倍数。: Maximum batch result size as a multiple of a single result.
新建协作任务默认允许的工作数量。: Default work item limit for new collaboration tasks.
填 0 不允许继续交接工作。: Use 0 to disable further work handoffs.
一项协作任务默认允许发起的执行次数。: Default execution limit within one collaboration task.
同一协作任务同时推进的工作数量。: Work items that can run at once within one collaboration task.
用于新建协作任务，已有任务保留创建时的时限。: Applies to new collaboration tasks. Existing deadlines stay in effect.
每次执行可带入的协作内容长度。: Maximum collaboration context included in an execution.
每次执行可带入的近期协作消息数量。: Maximum recent collaboration messages included in an execution.
每个运行环境可使用的内存上限。: Maximum memory available to each environment.
每个运行环境可使用的处理器核数。: CPU cores available to each environment.
每个运行环境可同时启动的进程数量。: Maximum simultaneous processes in each environment.
运行环境中临时目录的容量上限。: Maximum temporary directory size in each environment.
单次命令或文件操作的最长执行时间。: Maximum duration of a command or file operation.
多个站点共用服务器时，还受服务器总并发上限约束。: A shared server's total concurrency limit also applies.
达到上限后，需停止部分环境或等待空闲回收。: At the limit, stop unused environments or wait for idle cleanup.
空闲环境达到此时间后停止，工作文件保留。: Idle environments stop after this time. Work files are retained.
执行中或仍被活动任务使用的输出会继续保留。: Outputs still being produced or used by active tasks are retained.
与工作空间设置中的命令输出容量共同生效。: Applies together with the command output size in Workspace settings.
清理未使用的临时执行文件，持久项目文件保留。: Removes unused temporary execution files. Persistent project files are retained.
已过期通知的最终发送结果，至少保留 180 天。: Final delivery results for expired notifications, retained for at least 180 days.
调整任务并发、活动任务数量和排队时间。: Manage task concurrency, active task limits, and queue timeouts.
并发数降低后，正在执行的任务继续完成；排队时间对当前等待中的任务也生效。: Lower concurrency does not interrupt running tasks. Queue timeouts also apply to tasks already waiting.
调整模型请求和工具结果的设置。: Manage settings for model requests and tool results.
重试次数用于新提交的对话消息，其他设置用于后续模型请求和工具操作。: The retry limit applies to new conversation messages. Other changes apply to subsequent model requests and tool operations.
设置新建协作任务的默认限制和共享上下文大小。: Set defaults for new collaboration tasks and shared context limits.
任务默认值用于新建任务，共享上下文设置用于后续执行。: Task defaults apply to new tasks. Shared context settings apply to subsequent executions.
分配运行环境资源，管理命令并发和空闲回收。: Allocate environment resources and manage commands and idle cleanup.
内存、处理器、进程数和临时目录容量在新建环境时生效。已有环境需在「我的环境」停止: Memory, CPU, process, and temporary directory limits apply to new environments. Stop and reconnect existing environments in My environment.
管理临时文件、命令输出和通知记录的保留时间。: Manage retention for temporary files, command outputs, and notification records.
缩短保留时间后，超期记录会在后续清理中删除，删除后无法恢复。: Shorter retention removes expired records during subsequent cleanup. Deleted records cannot be restored.

请输入不小于 0 的整数，或选择不限。: Enter a nonnegative whole number, or select Unlimited.
超过此大小的部分由模型按需继续读取。: The model can read additional content as needed.
单次工具调用完整结果的大小上限。: Maximum size of a complete tool call result.
空闲时保持运行，可手动停止。: Stays running while idle. You can stop it manually.
